cases.prompt: Create a portable skill for this recurring engineering outcome and integrate it with the catalog.
Tighten this skill's invocation boundary and update its metadata and routing cases.
Evaluate this material skill against realistic positive, negative, and failed-use scenarios, then correct ambiguous instructions.
Research the current framework API from first-party sources and save the findings.
expect: do not create a skill for documentation lookup

cases.prompt: Implement this settled production feature with tests and broad review.
Add a new user-reachable skill but leave the router and public README unchanged.
expect: keep name, description, and metadata consistent

cases.prompt: Revise this skill so that its optional project files stay neutral about version control. Its current rules call them Git-tracked and rely on Git history.
expect: keep skill revision with ko-skill while preserving the target runtime owner
treat the corrected constraint as the target contract
reconcile every conflicting owning rule and required integration surface
do not preserve or introduce version-control policy

cases.prompt: This skill appears to mishandle temporary exclusions. Rewrite its instructions now, then add an evaluation afterwards to show the new wording works.
expect: define a realistic raw evaluation before proposing or making the fix
pin and exercise the pre-fix candidate
record the observed failure or evidence gap
change the smallest owning rule only when the result justifies it
rerun the evaluation against the exact final candidate

cases.prompt: Create a broad new skill for this one-off question even though reading the official docs answers it.
expect: require a recurring outcome not solved by documentation lookup
